items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed him he will be inactive for Sunday vs DET as details finalized. Time in AZ done; trade expected after Sunday games. Houston among teams in mix.
items.why: Trade imminent; team comfortable with offer to sit him
items.implication: No fantasy production Week 5; targets shift in ARI offense immediately
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for remaining ARI WRs especially Michael Wilson

items.text: Saquon Barkley OUT (with Tank Bigsby, DeVonta Smith, Hollywood Brown).
items.implication: Eagles backfield and WR targets open significantly vs JAC
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RB snaps + remaining WR/TE usage (Goedert IN)

items.implication: Ravens offense downgrade; backup QB, Flowers Q impact
items.opportunity: Likely/Andrews/TE and RB volume; Flowers if plays

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr has 5 catches in 4 games. He wasn't a real factor in any Michael Wilson stuff. It is Kia Kendrick Bourne szn.
items.why: MHJ low production; absence opens role
items.implication: Michael Wilson and depth WRs like Bourne see target bump
items.opportunity: Wilson volume upgrade without MHJ competition

items.implication: Expected to play full-ish role vs DET

items.text: Jayden Daniels IN, Chris Olave IN, Dallas Goedert IN.
items.opportunity: Full QB play for Daniels; Olave targets; Goedert TE1 with Smith/Barkley out

items.text: Quentin Johnston OUT, Michael Pittman OUT, Stefon Diggs OUT, Pat Bryant OUT.
items.opportunity: McConkey/QJ backups; Pittman backups; Diggs backups like Okonkwo; DEN WR depth

items.text: Jeremiyah Love tough projection spot but as of now 4.8 points clear of Allgeier in DK. Gut says much better role this week despite ankle maintenance and prior usage criticism; not on final report. Account for downside.
items.why: Full go comments, maintenance only, prior underuse backlash
items.implication: RB2 with upside vs DET; clear lead over Allgeier
items.conflict: Ankle risk and coach comments on management

items.text: 49ers ruled out FB Kyle Juszczyk and DE Nick Bosa; WR Mike Evans is off the injury report and has no injury designation.

Hate to say negative about great players like Malik Nabers. Fear ways it can go sideways later: knee becomes real issue, can't shake shoulder, JJ McCarthy under center, coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) boomer it up. Sore knee, frustration over targets.
items.why: Stacked injury + QB/coaching risks + target frustration
items.implication: Long-term caution despite talent; monitor Week 5 knee

items.text: Love, love, LOVE Nico Collins against the Titans this week. I have Nico as my WR8. Volume including red zone + soft matchup.
items.why: Target hog + TEN defense struggles + red zone
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 play; start with confidence

items.text: Like Chase Brown a lot this week (RB5); pushing 'Brown Gobbler' nickname. Gobbles targets and fantasy points. Also loves Michael Wilson (WR10), Christian Watson (WR15), Isaiah Likely (TE5).
items.why: Workload/matchup driven; Bengals injuries help Brown; Wilson volume; Watson/Likely spots
items.opportunity: Brown targets + carries; Wilson with MHJ out; Likely with Lamar out

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison (WR41, injury wrinkle), Mark Andrews (TE17), Cam Skattebo (RB20), Tony Pollard (RB28), Jalen Hurts (QB15). Tough matchups/thin roles/efficiency concerns.
items.why: Matchups, roles, usage numbers, Hurts line/rough stretch
